name: Animated Card, Colossal
body:

Hearts – Ranged +2 composite shortbow +7/+2 (1d10+20/x3)

Ranged 2 +1 darts +22/+17 (1d8+19)

Spades – Melee +1 greatsword +24/+19 (2d8+28/19-20)

STATISTICS

Str 46, Dex 9, Con -, Int -, Wis 1, Cha 1
Base Atk +13; CMB +39, CMD 48
Feats Dual SliceB, Power ThrowB, Rapid ShotB, Two-Weapon FightingB, Weapon Focus (shortbow)B

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or group (3-12)
